ابياضضن (form XI)
# اِبْيَاضَضْنَ (ibyāḍaḍna) /ib.jaː.dˤadˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
# اِبْيَاضِضْنَ (ibyāḍiḍna) /ib.jaː.dˤidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْيَاضَّ (ibyāḍḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
